target_claim: S1: Under frozen V1 PACS predictors, does the registered selection-rule superiority (vs strongest equal-info/equal-budget fixed procedures) transfer to a NEW external image domain (DomainNet), restricted to the same 7 PACS class names? No new testing principle; no predictor SOTA; no RATIO general-superiority claim; no geometry-alone causation claim.

do_not_edit: manuscript LaTeX/PDF in this seal step
scientific_freeze.on_KILL_or_HOLD: Manuscript keeps existing V1 HOLD narrative; may later add 'additional domain also non-transfer' limits language; do NOT reinterpret V1 as CONFIRM.
scientific_freeze.note: This seal is written before any DomainNet experiment outcomes exist or are viewed.

dataset.name: DomainNet
dataset.source_paper: Peng et al., Moment Matching for Multi-Source Domain Adaptation, ICCV 2019; https://ai.bu.edu/M3SDA/
dataset.domains_availability_gate: Use the 6 standard DomainNet domains if present. If Code later finds fewer, document availability gate as HOLD_VALIDITY/INVALID rather than silently changing the domain list.
dataset.class_filter: Images whose DomainNet label maps to these 7 names via case-insensitive exact match after strip. Other DomainNet classes are excluded.
dataset.missing_class_in_domain: If a required class is missing (empty after filter) in a domain needed for support, mark INVALID for that support requirement (same spirit as V1 domain_support_required).
dataset.class_split_rule: COPIED verbatim from V1 PROTOCOL identical known/unknown 4-of-7 lists (not re-derived under S1 protocol_id). Same five splits as FEDCORE-V1-PACS-20260916-v1.
dataset.identity: SHA256 of uint32-big-endian width,height followed by decoded EXIF-transposed RGB bytes
dataset.duplicate_rule: Collapse identical RGB content within a domain and class; conflicting class labels INVALID; same content across domains kept but assigned the same role
dataset.role_rule: H=int(SHA256(protocol_id|role|image_identity)); training if 5*H<3*2**256; proposal if 5*H<4*2**256; audit otherwise — with protocol_id = FEDCORE-S1-DOMAINNET-PACSCLS-20260923-v1
dataset.training_role_in_S1: UNUSED for training (predictors frozen). Training-role images may still be excluded from proposal/audit the same way as V1 role partitioning.
dataset.domain_support_required: All class/domain combinations present among the available domains after filter; nonempty proposal/audit per domain for each required support cell. Missing required support → INVALID (do not silently drop domains/classes).
dataset.note: This is NOT the standard DomainNet domain-generalization protocol. It is a federated open-set certification transfer probe restricted to the 7 PACS class name strings under frozen V1 predictors.

predictors.source: V1 PACS run checkpoints, 30/30 models (resnet18 + convnext_tiny × 5 splits × 3 seeds)
predictors.binding: Each S1 model row binds 1:1 to the corresponding V1 checkpoint (same arch/split/seed).
predictors.inference_transform: EXIF transpose/RGB; Resize(shorter=256,bilinear,antialias=True); CenterCrop(224); ToTensor; ImageNet mean/std — identical to V1
predictors.missing_checkpoint_policy: If any of 30 checkpoints missing → INCOMPLETE; do not substitute ImageNet-only or other-domain weights.

training.note: S1 forbids new training/retraining of predictors (재학습 금지). Training block from V1 is inherited only as historical provenance of frozen checkpoints; no S1 training loop.

candidate_family.scores: softmax-known max; logsumexp-known at T=1 (negative energy, higher accepts); top1-top2 known probability
candidate_family.proposal: pool all proposal domains unweighted by record; maximize accepted count subject to K/A<=gamma/5, A>=1; exact rational risk comparisons; tie smaller threshold
candidate_family.infeasible: reject-all slot retained in M=12; never replace
candidate_family.certified_selection: maximum common positive acceptance LCB; tie smaller gamma, lexical score alias, candidate index

audit.budget_unit: with-replacement audit draws, not unique acquired labels
audit.allocation: equal per client; note: DomainNet may have 6 domains — equal allocation splits primary/secondary budgets equally across the domains that pass availability (document realized per-domain draw counts; do not change total B).
audit.allocation_note_vs_V1: V1 had 4 PACS domains → 64/128/256 per domain at B=256/512/1024. S1 with 6 DomainNet domains uses equal allocation of the same total budgets (document floor/remainder rule in runner binding before GPU work). Changing total B after viewing outcomes is forbidden.
audit.draws: nested fixed-size prefixes; NumPy PCG64 uniform integer draws; no adaptive stopping
audit.draw_seed: Use frozen seed function with label=audit_draw and parts=[split,domain,replicate]; choose indices from source-identity-sorted domain audit list; protocol_id = this S1 id
audit.coupling: same (split,domain,replicate) stream across architectures, training seeds, all methods, both t and all budgets; independent replicate streams
audit.certifier_information: proposal eligibility plus n,A,K count tensors; no full-frame labels, error rates, future outcomes or full acceptance masks
audit.risk_engines: Exact Section 4.9 seven constructions and frozen stakes; RATIO retains own denominator gate; no tolerance-based enlargement of the safe set
audit.guarantee_scope: Per fixed model, budget, t and prespecified procedure; not simultaneous over all reported experiment rows
audit.full_frame_truth: Only post-decision evaluator may compute exact empirical risks and acceptance from full audit frame

procedures.diagnostic_role: Required report; not a fixed comparator and not part of S1 CONFIRM. A method-superiority claim would additionally need superiority over this composed control.

analysis.primary_metric: ECA=common acceptance lower bound of selected certified candidate; refusal=0
analysis.per_arch_estimand: Average over 5 fixed splits, 3 fixed training seeds (V1 frozen predictors), and two equally weighted protection tasks; expectation over fresh with-replacement draws conditional on all frozen DomainNet frames and frozen V1 predictors
analysis.statistical_unit: one complete audit-replicate block across all 30 models and all conditions; 100 independent RNG blocks conditional on fixed inputs
analysis.CI: paired percentile bootstrap of 100 replicate blocks, 20000 resamples, shared resample indices, method=linear quantiles .05/(2*16) and 1-.05/(2*16)
analysis.CI_scope: Approximate simultaneous conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty; not source-population, architecture-population, or finite-sample coverage guarantee
analysis.bootstrap_seed_note: NEW preregistered seed; do not reuse V1 resample stream id 2026091601 as outcome-dependent. Seed chosen before any DomainNet outcomes.
analysis.support: report all per-model deltas, per-split seed means, win/tie/loss and each t separately; no selective model exclusion
secondary: ECA by each budget and t
analysis.missing: retain full matrix; incomplete or failed run not treated as refusal or imputed zero

gates.CONFIRM: All 30 models and all primary rows complete and valid; in EACH architecture minimum of seven mean paired differences >=.01 AND all seven CI lowers >0
gates.KILL: Any architecture has any fixed-control CI upper <=0, OR in BOTH architectures minimum mean fixed-control difference <.002
gates.HOLD: Complete valid result that is neither CONFIRM nor KILL; do not expand budget/replicates or change endpoints after viewing outcome
gates.INVALID: Leakage, changed outcome-dependent knobs, wrong certification, unequal information/budgets or source binding failure; or silent domain/class list change after outcomes
gates.HOLD_VALIDITY: For any of 30*3*2*7=1260 model-budget-t-fixed-method groups, exact Bin(100,.10) upper-tail p at observed joint-family-failure count <=.05/1260; investigate without claiming performance PASS. No flag does not prove validity. Also: DomainNet archive/domain availability shortfalls documented before GPU work.
gates.joint_failure_event: Any deployment-eligible risk-passing candidate has true empirical worst-mixture risk >alpha OR any candidate common acceptance LCB exceeds its true worst-mixture acceptance. Full-frame truth computed after decisions only.
gates.INCOMPLETE: Any missing required model or primary outcome or resource stop; any of 30 V1 checkpoints missing
gates.new_policy_superiority: NOT implied by CONFIRM against fixed procedures
gates.manuscript_policy_on_nonCONFIRM: On KILL or HOLD for S1: keep V1 HOLD narrative; optional later limits language that additional domain also non-transfer; NEVER reinterpret V1 as CONFIRM.

denominators.note: Row denominators match V1 structure (30 models × replicates × t × procedures × budgets). Domain count affects per-client allocation of draws inside each budget, not these row counts.

must_pass_before_GPU_work.gate: DomainNet archive present on research host with SHA recorded
All 7 class names nonempty across required domains after filtering
All 30 V1 checkpoints present and hash-bound
Runner wiring dry-check PASS without touching test outcomes

availability_gates.fail_policy: Do not start inference/cert GPU work until all four gates PASS. Document HOLD_VALIDITY/INVALID/INCOMPLETE rather than silently changing design.

resources.GPU_hours_note: Cap for inference+cert only; no training

box_reachability.recommended_path: Human/Mac enables local-execution and ssh to ubuntu-4070 for DomainNet archive + 30 ckpt probe before any GPU work

preexecution_notes: S1 sealed BEFORE any DomainNet experiment outcomes are viewed.
Predictors are frozen V1 PACS checkpoints; no relearning.
Class splits copied identically from V1; role hashes use S1 protocol_id.
Equal-info/equal-budget fixed procedures remain the CONFIRM comparators; GEOMETRY_DIRECT_CP remains diagnostic only.
